title: Hang a push mower's grass bag: hold its sprung rear flap up, seat the bag's rod in both hooks, lower the flap onto it
instruction: A corded 14 in push mower stands on the bench with its rear toward you, unplugged and with no blade. Its spring-loaded ejector flap hangs shut in front of the two coupling hooks on its rear face. Its empty grass bag stands on the bench behind it, the steel rod across the bag's mouth toward the mower. Fit the bag as the mower's manual says: raise the ejector flap and hold it up, set the bag's rod down into both coupling hooks so it rests on the floor of each, then release the flap so it closes onto the bag, and take both hands off the bag and the flap. Do not lift the mower or slide it sideways, and keep it on the bench; a small roll on its wheels is fine.
context: The mower's manual (Snow Joe, Sun Joe MJ401E operator's manual, Form No. SJ-MJ401E-880E-MR7, p. 7): "Raise the spring loaded ejector flap and move the grass bag up to the mower body. Fasten it onto the coupling hooks (Fig. 6).", then "Release the ejector flap to secure the grass bag in position (Fig 7)." The same manual warns (p. 1): "Do not operate without the entire grass catcher, discharge guard, rear guard or other safety protective devices in place and in proper working order." A bag hanging from one hook, or a flap left propped open, is not a fitted catcher.
setup: Coordinates: x forward from the arm bases (at y +-0.305), y left, z up from the bench top. Mower (Sun Joe MJ401E, 13.2 kg, 14 in, rear toward the arms; drawn and collided as boxes and cylinders, ABS plastic): rear face at x 0.53; rear housing x 0.53 to 0.59, y +-130 mm, z 20 to 400 mm; deck x 0.59 to 0.91 (the bench's far edge), y +-180 mm, z 30 to 200 mm; motor cover x 0.65 to 0.87, y +-120 mm, z 200 to 300 mm; four 140 mm wheels, 40 mm wide, at x 0.63 and 0.83, y +-200 mm; handle folded forward (drawn only). It rolls fore and aft on its wheels (a slide with 3.9 N of friction and 10 N s/m of damping, from 150 mm back to 80 mm forward, where its front wheels reach the bench edge) and cannot slide sideways or tip. Two steel coupling hooks on the rear face at y +-80 mm (160 mm apart), each 16 mm wide: a floor plate 25 mm deep and 4 mm thick standing out of the rear face, its top 285 mm above the bench, and at its back a lip 4 mm thick and 20 mm tall, leaving a 21 mm slot between lip and rear face. Ejector flap: plastic plate 240 x 100 mm, 4 mm thick, 0.15 kg, with a 20 mm lip bent toward the arms along its lower edge; hinged along y at x 0.49, z 355 mm on two brackets (y +-119 to 131 mm); it hangs shut 15 mm in front of the hooks' lips, its lower edge 30 mm below their floor; torsion spring 0.15 N m/rad, 0.20 N m closing torque when shut, damper 0.10 N m s/rad; opens to 125 deg. Grass bag (MJ401E-10, 40 l, rigid in the sim, 1.0 kg): body 500 x 300 x 267 mm (x, y, z) of polyester fabric (0.445 kg) with an 8 mm hard plastic top cover (0.30 kg); a 10 mm steel rod, 300 mm long along y, across the mouth 32 mm in front of the bag's front face on two 10 mm steel arms at y +-140 mm (0.205 kg); a plastic carry handle, a 16 mm bar 150 mm long along y on two posts at y +-70 mm, its centre 40 mm over the cover and over the bag's centre of mass, 221 mm behind the rod. Friction (static / dynamic): fabric 0.60 / 0.55, steel 0.40 / 0.35, plastic 0.45 / 0.40, rubber 0.80 / 0.75, bench 0.5 / 0.5, averaged per pair. Start: the bag stands on its bottom on the bench, mouth toward the mower, the rod's centre at x 0.4345, y 0, 262 mm up; by seed (numpy default_rng(seed)) moved 0 to 10 mm back, +-15 mm sideways and turned +-3 deg about the rod's centre. The flap is shut, the mower at the start of its slide (front wheels 80 mm from the bench edge).
scoring: Only the last step counts (and the 1 s hold of the top rung). Everything is measured in the mower's own frame, so rolling the mower does not change a fit. Rod seated in both hooks: for each hook, three stations across it (its two sides, each widened 5 mm, and its middle) must each lie on the rod's actual 300 mm length (never on its axis extended past an end), with the rod's centre there inside that hook's slot (between the lip and the rear face, with 2 mm allowed on each wall for the colliders' contact offset) and resting on the hook's floor: from 0.5 mm below to 1.5 mm above where a rod lying on the floor has its centre. A rod turned more than 60 deg from the line of the hooks fails both, and the bag must be upright (its cover within 30 deg of level). 0: not seated in both hooks (the rod in one hook only, ending inside a hook, on the lip tops, behind the flap, the bag upside down, or on the bench). 0.25: seated. 0.5: and no point of either gripper (fingers or housing) within 30 mm of the bag, and the bag still (under 5 mm/s and under 0.05 rad/s). 0.75: and the flap's free edge resting on the bag: three points along it (at y -100, 0 and 100 mm) over the bag's top cover, each from 3 mm below to 5 mm above it. 0.9: and no point of either gripper within 30 mm of the flap, the flap still (under 0.05 rad/s), and the mower safely on the bench: rolled no more than 60 mm forward from its start, so its front wheels stay 20 mm or more inside the bench edge. 1.0: 0.9 held for 1 s (success). Any roll backward, and up to 60 mm forward, never lowers the score. Hands that cannot be read count as touching (unread hands give at most 0.25). Nothing can break; no other history is kept.
reset_notes: Two roll stops stay clamped to the bench for every trial: a batten (or wheel chocks) in front of the front wheels, set so the mower can roll at most 80 mm forward (front wheels then at the bench edge, the sim's forward stop), and one behind the rear wheels at 150 mm of roll back; the score's 60 mm limit leaves 20 mm before the forward stop. Nothing consumed: lift the bag off the hooks, close the flap, roll the mower back to its taped mark and stand the bag on its taped outline, then move it for the trial's seed: 0 to 10 mm back and up to 15 mm sideways (a steel rule from the outline's tape), turned up to 3 deg about the rod's centre (a protractor on the outline's front edge). The seed's three values are printed by bag_layout(seed) in mower_bag.py.
fidelity: Rigid bag and flap; real contact for the rod in the hooks, the flap on the bag and every grip. The manual's bent support rod (Fig. 4) is modelled as its straight cross-piece on two arms; the flap's size is an estimate from Fig. 7 and narrower than the real rear door. The mower slides fore and aft only. Estimates, to be measured on the real mower: hooks, flap size, mass and spring, bag shape and masses (bag 1.0 kg, flap 0.15 kg), all friction, the roll friction (3.9 N) and damping.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 (1,200 steps); demo: 1.0 (success at 36.4 s, step 728)
